info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v2-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Guest Pass API provides access to view available guest passes for fitness memberships. This endpoint enables users to retrieve details about guest pass options, allowing potential clients to evaluate available offerings. The API is particularly useful for fitness centers and gyms aiming to promote guest access, allowing visitors to explore membership benefits. Typical consumers of this API include fitness center administrators and marketing teams who wish to enhance user engagement and attract new memberships.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access information about guest pass memberships, including terms, conditions, and eligibility criteria. Utilize this to understand membership options available for guests.
